description: Materials as data with three.js's classic parameters (color, map, roughness, emissive, flags); the engine decides how to draw them.

fields.description: What it is for, in plain sentences.
The base colour, hex; it multiplies the map (three.js's color).

The texture generator that fills the maps: a texture id ('texture:brick'), or { texture, seed, params, size, look, repeat }; null for none. Its height becomes the normal map, its roughness the roughness map, its emissive the emissive map.
Microfacet roughness, 0 (mirror) to 1 (matte), for the styles that shade with it (pbr, WP 7.2).
How metallic, 0 to 1, for the styles that shade with it (pbr, WP 7.2).
The colour it glows with, hex, unaffected by light; it multiplies the map's emissive, as three.js's emissiveMap does (write '#ffffff' to show a glowing texture as baked).
How deep the map's relief looks: scales the normal map from its height (0 turns it off).
Drawn without lights (glTF unlit, three.js MeshBasicMaterial): color × map as it is; for glows, skies and markers.
Blended with what is behind it, by opacity.
Texels with alpha below this are not drawn (cut-outs).
Multiplies by the geometry's color attribute.
Whether it writes depth (off for some transparent layers).
How the gallery shows it (engine/core/gallery.ts; x gallery, #gallery/<kind>/<id>): its camera, how long it plays and the states it is shown in.

properties.description: How the gallery frames it: `turntable` (Four views round it, a quarter turn apart, from 25° up, fitted to its size.), `front` (One view from its front left, 25° up, fitted to its size.), or a camera code drawn as written.
How long it plays: four frames, one in each quarter's middle; 0 for a still (a move's or an emitter's: its own length).
The states it is shown in, one frame each (a body's: a sample state, a pose or a stance).
